html.body: Date: 2025-04-29 PATENTU.S. Patent Application No. 18/757,746 Attorney Docket No. 19-1114-US-DIV REMARKSBy this present amendment, Applicant proposes amending claim 19 to improve form. No new matter has been added. Applicant respectfully requests that this amendment be entered, and the application passed to issue.As required by MPEP § 714.16, Applicant submits that the proposed amendment merely corrects formal matters and does not change the scope of the claims. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests entry of this Amendment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.312.To the extent necessary, a petition for an extension of time under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136 is hereby made. Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account No. 50-1070 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.Respectfully submitted, HARRITY & HARRITY, LLPBy: / Nathan Gundlach, Reg.
